title: Lina Khan – FTC Chair on Amazon Antitrust Lawsuit & AI Oversight | The Daily Show
summary: FTC Chair Lina Khan sits down with Jon Stewart on The Daily Show to discuss the agency's work protecting consumers from unfair business practices. Topics include the FTC's antitrust lawsuit against Amazon, healthcare industry actions, and whether tech companies are racing to control AI.
why: HN commenters point to it as a plain-language, well-conducted interview that explains what the FTC is doing about monopolization and antitrust.

quote.text: she pretty much sketched out (in the limited time she got) the main forces at work in the past 30 years of monopolization
